title: MLLMGUARD: A Multi-dimensional Safety Evaluation Suite for Multimodal Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multimodal responses to adversarial image-text pairs (red teaming) that prompt models to link facial features or appearances to predetermined characteristics (e.g., intelligence, income, sexual orientation), associate negative traits with specific social groups (malicious labeling), or make discriminatory decisions (e.g., HR recruiting risks). Responses are scored using an Attack Success Degree (ASD) and Perfect Answer Rate (PAR) by human annotators and a specialized automated evaluator (GuardRank).
